title: Conditional κ = 7.25113717934416e-4: target-prefix compression (280 groups) composed with #280's gen4 retiming, early restorations and dirty entrances
body:
Conditional κ = `725113717934416422443945/10^27` = **7.25113717934416e-4**: +9.25 × 10⁻⁷ (+0.128 %) over [#280](https://github.com/CrocSwap/integer-mult-bounds/pull/280) (7.24189082265949e-4), +2.24 × 10⁻⁶ over #276. Stacked on #280's branch at its head (`codex/gen4-compatible-improvement`), as a copy of its package with one added stage; #280's own package is untouched.

**Full replay: PASS** on the committed package: #276 baseline (nine stages), #280's export/retime/cleanup/entrances, the target-prefix stage, columns, charts, price and admission — `PASS kappa = 0.000725113717934416422443945`, `PASS_IMMUTABLE_COMPOSED_GEN4_CONSTRUCTION`. #283 (Dugongue), published meanwhile, composes #279's squares and #280's levers with 741 fresh gen4 kernel pivots and sixteen sinks at 7.26111e-4 and is above this PR; this package remains the verified #280 + target-prefix composition.

## What is composed

#280 = gen4 (#276) + the 880 common-frame retimings (the same ones as #279) + 440 early helper restorations + 60 transported dirty entrances + fixed prime. #279 = gen4 + the 880 retimings + 220 target-prefix squares. The two were complementary; this PR adds the target-prefix compression onto #280's final word as a native stage (`code/target_prefix.py`, the stage of #273/#279; the mechanism is eumemic's #268).

On #280's word, **280 disjoint target groups** qualify: the 220 squares of four targets (three retained, one dependent) plus 60 pairs created by #280's transported entrances. Each dependent's frame-20 prefix response is the F₂ sum of its retained group-mates'; its 1,190 frame-20 reads are omitted, it receives `t −= p_j` at the zero frame at the cut and `t += p_j` at the group's common nondegenerate 21-dimensional frame at the close, where all members are moved (1,440 setup/restore additions). Local paid histogram delta {1: −220, 2: −54, 3: −36, 18: −66, 19: −24, 20: −190, 21: +280} at unchanged rank mass: normalized calls 5,808,240 → 5,789,640, stock 255,841 and deficit 52,800 unchanged.

The stage recomputes every member's literal prefix response from the actual transcript and requires the dependency before emitting anything; it also requires that no member is used as a source or receives a target before its close, rebuilds every MOVE from the actual needs, checks nested chains, fixed endpoints and COPY lifetimes, nondegenerate endpoint bases, and runs both all-column replays with an omitted-setup negative control. It rewrites `candidate/COHORT249-RECORDS.bin` (keeping the pre-compression word alongside) and every downstream #280 checker re-reads the word. Changes to #280's files are confined to `code/price.py` (the pinned call count 5,789,640 and κ) and `verify.py` (the new stage and the composed word's SHA-256 `00704c44a562a115454152cff41f1b39ec5491be192b1e792855a8541c3f34ee`).

## Reproduce

```sh
python3 -m pip install -r research/gen4-retiming-entrances-target/requirements.txt
python3 -B research/gen4-retiming-entrances-target/verify.py --output /tmp/gen4-target-replay
```

Python 3.11+, SymPy 1.14.0, C++17 compiler and Boost headers; new output directory outside the package; no network.

## Scope and credits

Exactly #280/#276's hypotheses and conditional interfaces; no unconditional multiplication bound, benchmark or new Lean proof is claimed.
